lanes.summary: The PR perfectly fulfills the PMAT-3685 ticket requirements. It maps capability mismatches during CUDA initialization to a new ParityRefusal path (exit 12) carrying the required stderr line, and leaves other initialization errors as exit 5. It ensures this behavior is robustly tested (proving the mutation) and refactors the unsupported quant checks so they don't drift. The bash evaluation scripts correctly identify the UNMEASURED-TOOL output and mark it as a REPORT rather than FAIL. No requirements were violated and no gates were weakened.

findings.claim: The test parity_refusal_3685_cuda_init_error_maps_refusal_to_12_and_the_rest_to_5 correctly ensures that capability refusals map to exit 12 and other failures map to 5, which tests the mutation.
The check_model_parity.sh script handles the UNMEASURED-TOOL output (exit 12 + REFUSAL) by treating it as a REPORT rather than FAIL, safely resolving the issue.
